composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Validate required fields first so a missing/blank field is a 400 with an 'errors'
# array. This step binds the body once and republishes it for BuildOwner.
validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  next: checkTelephoneUnique

# Reject a normalized telephone already used by another owner (409). Reads within the
# same write transaction so the uniqueness check and the insert see one consistent view.
checkTelephoneUnique:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckTelephoneUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkHouseholdUnique

# Reject a last name + address already used together by another owner (409), unless the request
# opts in via 'sharesHousehold'. Reads within the same write transaction as the insert.
checkHouseholdUnique:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckHouseholdUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: defaultRegistrationDate

# When the client supplied no registrationDate, stamp today's server date; a supplied
# date is kept as-is. Runs before save so the resolved date is persisted.
defaultRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.DefaultRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

# Assign the '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' customer code. NNNN is one more than the current owner
# count; runs before save (within the write transaction) so it counts only owners
# already persisted, giving each new owner the next global sequence number.
assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdId

# Assign the stable, shared householdId derived from the normalized last name + address, so owners
# in the same household (accepted via 'sharesHousehold') share one identifier. Runs before save so
# the id is persisted and returned.
assignHouseholdId:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

# Count existing owners sharing this owner's firstName + lastName (case-insensitively). Runs before
# save within the write transaction so it counts only owners already persisted, excluding this new one.
assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. Optional on
            create; when omitted the server sets it to the current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner already has
            the same last name and address (they intentionally share a household).
            Write-only; not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: FRA-0007
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners who live in the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned at creation and returned.
              type: string
              example: 3F9A1C7E5B2D
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:

## Summary

I implemented `membershipNumber` as a derived, read-only response field formatted `<customerCode>-M<YY>`, where YY is the last two digits of the `registrationDate` year.

Since it's a pure derivation of two fields already on the owner (like the existing `displayName`/`initials` derived fields), I computed it at response-mapping time rather than persisting it — no new entity field, DB column, or pipeline step needed.

**Two changes:**

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a `membershipNumber` read-only property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes it.

2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — added `@Mapping(target = "membershipNumber", expression = "java(membershipNumber(owner))")` on `toOwnerDto`, plus a null-safe helper:
   ```java
   default String membershipNumber(Owner owner) {
       if (owner.getCustomerCode() == null || owner.getRegistrationDate() == null) return null;
       return owner.getCustomerCode() + "-M"
               + String.format("%02d", owner.getRegistrationDate().getYear() % 100);
   }
   ```
   The `%02d` handles years like 2007 → `07`, and the null guard keeps owners lacking a `customerCode`/`registrationDate` (e.g. seed data) mapping cleanly instead of throwing.
